note: Lean states the lower bound `c‖p‖` as a local uniform estimate (`Wide.cone`) and keeps the cutoff's bounded subtraction inside `Blanket` and the proof of holomorphy, rather than the decomposition through q_j. The arity-zero normalization is carried separately (`Outfield.soak`).

structure Wide (n : ℕ) : Prop where
  rim p y : p∈coneM n → y∈shores n → 0 ≤ inner ℝ p y
  cone (y : Points n) (p : y∈fields n) : ∃ c : ℝ,0<c ∧ ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 y,∀ p∈coneM n,c * ‖p‖ ≤ inner ℝ p u

proof_context.conclusion: On `coneM n` the pairing with heights in `shores` is nonnegative and, locally uniformly at heights in `fields`, at least `c * ‖p‖`.

snippet.text:
structure Modified : Prop where
  actual : ∀ y ∈ shores n, HasTemperateGrowth (B.attenuate y)
  seen (f : Joint n) : ContinuousOn (fun y => B.diffuser y f) (shores n)

proof_context.conclusion: The damping multipliers `attenuate y` have temperate growth and `diffuser y f` is continuous in `y` on `shores n` for every joint test.

structure FullBody (F : Waves S) : Prop where
  hol (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (X.emit v) (tube n)
  builds (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (y : Points n) (hy : y∈fields n) (f : Joint n) :
    (D n).partialD (W.W n v) y f= ∫ x,X.emit v (glow x y) * f x
  leaned (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (y : Points n) (hy : y∈fields n) (f : Joint n) :
    Integrable (fun x => X.emit v (glow x y) * f x)
  pure (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (x : Points n) (y : Heights n) (hp : y∈east n) : X.emit v (glow x (dawn y)) = F.restricted v y x

proof_context.conclusion: `emit v` is holomorphic on `tube n`, its boundary pairing gives `partialD`, and at imaginary heights `emit v (glow x (dawn y)) = F.restricted v y x`.
